source.notes: POST /sap/bc/adt/debugger?method=stepContinue against the $TMP probe class ZCL_I89_PROBE, suspended in IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN, on the first pass through a DO 5 TIMES loop that increments LV_TOTAL from 0 to 1. The 200 response is a <dbg:step> root carrying a <reachedWatchpoints> block: watchpoint id="1", expired="false", variableName="LV_TOTAL", <currentValue>1 </currentValue> — this reduced row shape has no oldValue element; the prior value has to be read back separately via GET /debugger/watchpoints (see watchpoint-list-after-hit). This is the issue's primary "watchpoint hit" evidence. Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
